name: coldpin
description: Inspect npx packages cold in memory, verify tarball-to-source parity, and pin verified clean releases with zero execution.
suggestedPrompts: Discover a vetted npx CLI tool for JSON formatting and inspect its latest tarball before running it.
Inspect this npm package or local .tgz tarball cold for credential exfiltration, lifecycle hooks, and Git drift.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect npx tools cold and pin clean anchors
